summary: Get content property for page by id
description:
Retrieves a specific Content Property by ID that is attached to a specified page.

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to view the page.

parameters.name: page-id
parameters.description: The ID of the page for which content properties should be returned.

parameters.name: property-id
parameters.description: The ID of the content property being requested.

200.description: Returned if the requested content property is successfully retrieved.

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.

404.description:
Returned if the calling user does not have permission to view the
specified page, the page was not found, or the property was not found.
